new_claims.statement: If U,Z are independent and jointly independent of arbitrary (V,S), with scalar marginal density caps M_U,M_V,M_Z, then 2aUV+H(V,S)+b(Z+theta(V,S))^2 has density cap 3*2^(2/3)(M_U M_V M_Z)^(2/3)|a|^(-2/3)|b|^(-1/3).

In the exact-rank-three heavy-isotropic branch, pure transverse square-bank coefficient norm rho gives density cap 3*2^(4/3)c^(-1/3)rho^(-2/3)|det Lambda|^(-1/3), hence <9.524406312 rho^(-2/3) under c>1/2 and target normalization.

peer_result_applied.actual_application: Applied to the fully separated heavy-isotropic bank to obtain 4*2^(3/4)c^(-1/4)rho^(-1)/sqrt(B|tau|), exposing the anisotropy tax repaired by the new near/far split.
